name: gold-commerce-platform
description: Production-oriented Gold Jewellery E-commerce Platform monorepo

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@gold-commerce/shared-types --if-present && npm run build --workspace=@gold-commerce/validation --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend
scripts.build:netlify: npm run build:packages && npx prisma generate --schema=apps/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm --workspace=@gold-commerce/frontend run build
